profile.name: Soliman
profile.headline: Native software, TV systems, and installable builds.
profile.subhead: Building Windows tools, sideloadable iOS applications, Android TV experiences, and local AI pipelines with direct executable releases.
profile.bio: Independent software engineer focused on practical native tooling across iOS, Android TV, Windows, and FastAPI backends. Every shipped tool prioritizes zero-friction local networking, tactile hardware integration, and direct distribution.

certificates.title: Certificate of AI Usage
certificates.summary: Verified credential covering practical AI workflow integration, prompt engineering, model governance, and responsible applied deployment.

certificates.title: Introduction to AI
certificates.summary: Foundational certification covering machine learning principles, generative AI architectures, evaluation, and real-world product integration.

projects.title: AeroLoad
projects.tagline: Windows iOS sideloading suite, 7-day auto-refresher, and Apple Wallet AeroCard studio.
projects.description: High-performance Windows desktop suite featuring streaming PC-wide IPA indexing, Apple CgBI icon decoding, one-click Wi-Fi and USB signing with zsign, automated 7-day background refresh, AeroCard 3D Apple Wallet skinning via airlift without jailbreak, and Lockscreen Passcode Keypad theming.

projects.title: OpenWii Mario Kart TV
projects.tagline: 3D WebGL Mario Kart for Android TV driven by phone gyroscope steering.
projects.description: Standalone Android TV application pairing Three.js 3D stadium racing with a low-latency WebSocket motion server (8484/8485). Up to four phones join simultaneously as Wii Remote tilt wheels with custom gamepad focus handling tuned for 1280x720 Android TV screens.

projects.title: TV Companion (CouchTV + Kart)
projects.tagline: Native iOS shell for CouchTV menu control and 60 Hz CoreMotion Mario Kart steering.
projects.description: Sideloadable iOS WKWebView application connecting directly to Google TV over local HTTP and WebSocket without requiring Safari HTTPS certificates or prompts. Bridges native CoreMotion (CMMotionManager) at 60 Hz directly into the Wii Remote controller iframe.

projects.title: GateHop VPN Companion
projects.tagline: Live VPNGate latency prober with fastest-node selection and OpenVPN export.
projects.description: SwiftUI iPhone utility that parses live VPNGate OpenVPN feeds, measures real TCP handshake latency in milliseconds using Network.framework (NWConnection), filters by fastest node or custom country, auto-refreshes every 5 minutes, and exports .ovpn configs to OpenVPN Connect.

projects.title: CouchTV Custom On-TV Build
projects.tagline: Ad-free smart TV launcher and phone remote with integrated Mario Kart lobby.
projects.description: Custom Android TV APK and React/Vite phone remote featuring glass clock screens, unified Continue Watching, Sleep Timer, local CA HTTPS profile provisioning for iOS, and direct launching into the OpenWii Mario Kart lobby.

projects.title: StillClock
projects.tagline: Developer syntax clock with Jordan Awqaf prayer times and 3-day weather.
projects.description: Minimalist iOS dark-mode clock styled as const now = code structure, integrating Jordan Awqaf (Method 23) prayer calculations across 12 cities, +30m/-10m dynamic Athan countdown states, home screen WidgetKit support, and a 3-day weather forecast.

projects.title: WinDock
projects.tagline: iPhone tactile Wi-Fi squircle dock and StandBy clock for Windows app launching.
projects.description: Pairs an iOS frosted Cupertino app dock (8-app grid or 4-app + live StandBy clock layout) with a Windows listener to launch browsers, IDEs, games, and custom .exe commands over local Wi-Fi.

projects.title: Heartive iOS
projects.tagline: Native iPhone media wrapper with dark midnight chrome and fullscreen playback.
projects.description: SwiftUI iOS wrapper featuring a 5-tab navigation shell (Home, Movies, Series, Search, My List), inline playback controls, and automatic landscape orientation handling for video streams.

projects.title: Heartive TV
projects.tagline: Leanback fullscreen Android TV client with D-Pad focus navigation.
projects.description: Native Android TV APK compiled with Leanback launcher support, hardware acceleration, cleartext LAN support, and remote D-Pad mapping for big-screen viewing.

projects.title: Tracker Android
projects.tagline: Minimal daily checklist APK with Room persistence and automated 12:00 PM resets.
projects.description: Native Android app built with Room database, swipe-to-delete with undo, live completion progress bar, and reboot-safe AlarmManager scheduling that resets daily tasks at noon.

projects.title: Tracker Release Site
projects.tagline: Static web landing and direct APK distribution page deployed for Tracker.
projects.description: Clean dark-surface landing page showcasing Tracker features, interactive visual previews, and one-tap APK distribution configured for Vercel hosting.

projects.description: Personal AI orchestration server supporting extensible tool connectors and LLM provider routing, paired with an iOS SwiftUI app featuring Speech recognition and AVFoundation voice interaction.

projects.title: Youvid 3D Studio
projects.tagline: Automated AI video director and Three.js 3D scene renderer.
projects.description: FastAPI production server combining automated prompt-to-storyboard direction (director.py) with deterministic 3D Three.js stage rendering and MP4 output synthesis.

projects.title: Dawood67 Samsung Remote
projects.tagline: Native iPhone hardware-volume remote and 257+ app launcher for rooted Samsung Tizen TV.
projects.description: Connects directly to Vetro on Samsung Tizen TVs over LAN, intercepts iPhone physical Volume Up/Down presses to send XF86Audio volume keys, renders 34 D-Pad/media controls, and searches 257+ installed TV apps.

projects.title: Year View Calendar
projects.tagline: Native EventKit full-year iOS calendar built with GitHub Actions IPA automation.
projects.description: Compact year-at-a-glance iOS calendar reading native EventKit calendars so months, density, and schedules remain scannable on mobile screens.

projects.title: DawoodCounter
projects.tagline: Native iOS signed tally and quick counter application.
projects.description: Lightweight Swift utility for fast one-handed counting, persistent totals, and tactile haptic increments on iPhone.

projects.title: PrimeMovies & PrimeCinemas

projects.description: Native Swift iPhone application for browsing curated movies and cinema listings with automated cloud IPA builds.

projects.title: DawoodFiles

projects.description: Personal media bridge enabling iPhone file indexing and casting directly to a rooted Samsung Tizen smart TV on the local network.

projects.title: DawoodList

projects.description: Distraction-free iOS checklist app tailored for fast daily task capture and automated GitHub Actions IPA distribution.

projects.title: macOS Tiger Lake OpenCore EFI & WhateverXe Lab
projects.tagline: Sanitized OpenCore EFI (MacBookPro16,2), custom Darwin ACPI patches, and 64-bit Mach-O kext analysis scripts.
projects.description: Custom OpenCore EFI bundle for 11th Gen Intel Tiger Lake laptops with MacBookPro16,2 SMBIOS (hardware serials redacted), SSDT-NVME_OFF.dsl/.aml Darwin _OSI patch, VoodooI2C/AirportItlwm/AMFIPass kext configuration, and PowerShell 64-bit Mach-O binary inspection scripts for WhateverXe.kext.

projects.title: Ne3ma MVPN

projects.description: Jetpack Compose Android application built around VpnService split-tunneling for Facebook Messenger (com.facebook.orca) using live VPNGate feeds with server bandwidth, latency, and reachability ranking.

projects.description: Portable desktop speech studio (Voyce-win32-x64) running Chatterbox English & Arabic Multilingual V3 models locally with smart number-to-word expansion, custom WAV player, and buffered live voice changing.
